class.name: AudioEffectSymphonyReverb
class.brief_description: Symphony FDN late reverb with shoebox early reflections for shared wet buses.
class.description: A physically oriented reverb used by the Symphony spatial reverb pool. Combines stereo early reflections from a shoebox image-source model with an 8-line feedback delay network. Parameters are published through a seqlock so the main thread can call [method set_room] every frame while the audio thread processes. Typical wet-bus setup: [member dry] = [code]0[/code], [member wet] = [code]1[/code], [member auto_predelay] enabled so the late tail starts at the first reflection.

method.name: set_room
method.description: Atomically updates decay time, HF decay ratio, room dimensions, and early-reflection coefficient.

method.name: compute_first_reflection_ms
method.description: Returns the first-reflection delay in milliseconds for the given shoebox dimensions (metres).

members.member: Ratio of high-frequency T60 to broadband T60. Lower values damp highs faster.
Shoebox width, height, and depth in metres for early reflections and mean delay.
Gain of the early-reflection contribution relative to the late FDN.
Wall reflection coefficient for early taps (typically [code]sqrt(1 - alpha_mean)[/code]).
When [code]true[/code], late-reverb pre-delay follows the first reflection time.
Manual pre-delay in milliseconds when [member auto_predelay] is [code]false[/code].
Dry mix level. Wet buses usually keep this at [code]0[/code].
